turns.message: On 14 March 2024 I bought hair gummies for ₹799 on Amazon from the seller Mosaic Wellness. They were delivered on 17 March 2024 and I took one a day for six days, during which I had stomach pain, vomiting and dizziness. Then I noticed on the pack that the product had already expired in February 2024. I contacted Amazon on 23 March 2024 asking to return it for a refund, but they rejected the request saying the item is non-returnable and outside the return window.

expected.rationale: Refund denied, exact purchase and return-request dates, support contacted, grievance officer not mentioned.
